name: Nat One
source:
It only takes a pebble to start a rockslide. A spark to start an inferno. A shot to start a revolution. That’s called the butterfly effect. It makes something like a simple dice roll carry a lot of weight. Especially when that roll lands on a natural one.

All of a sudden, a life that was going well begins falling apart. Tyler desperately scrambles and clings onto the one last good thing he (thinks) he has left: a long-running DnD campaign that ended with a cruel twist of bad luck. But... Is escapism really the glue that can hold a crumbling life together?

[From [url=https://spirigladier.itch.io/nat-one]Itch.io[/url]]
